title: SI No. 1 of 2024 – Customs and Excise Duties (Amendment of Schedule) (No.1) Order, 2024
text:
Customs and Excise Duties
BELIZE:
CUSTOMS AND EXCISE DUTIES (AMENDMENT OF
SCHEDULE) (NO. 1) ORDER, 2024
ARRANGEMENT OF PARAGRAPHS
1. Citation.
2. Amendment of Schedule II.
3. Commencement.

No. 1] Customs and Excise Duties 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 1 of 2024
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for finance in
exercise of the powers conferred upon him by section
21(3) of the Customs and Excise Duties Act, Chapter
48 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2020, and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 12th January, 2024).
1. This Order may be cited as the
Citation.
CUSTOMS AND EXCISE DUTIES (AMENDMENT
OF SCHEDULE) (NO. 1) ORDER, 2024.
2. Schedule II of the Customs and Excise Duties Act is Amendment
of Schedule II.
amended by substituting the following rate of duty for the
CAP. 48.
rate of duty appearing therein opposite the following Tariff
Sub-heading–
Tariff Heading no. BZ Description of Goods Rate of Excise Duty
2710.12.20 00 Motor Spirit (Gasoline) $ 4.32/Imperial Gallon
3. This Order shall come into force on the 12th day of Commencement.
January, 2024.
MADE by the Minister responsible for finance this 11th day
of January, 2024.
HON. JOHN BRICEÑO
Prime Minister
(Minister responsible for finance)
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
#1 Power Lane, Belmopan, Belize, C.A.
